changes.detail: Start the configured loopback API before Expo; reuse a running API and check database access first.
Bounded readiness checks, startup errors, owned child process cleanup, regression tests and startup documentation.

summary: The combined launcher now starts the missing API and checks the database before Expo. Localhost login requests reach the authentication service.

validation.name: Startup regression tests
validation.detail: 3 tests passed: managed-origin restrictions, readiness failure handling, actual child startup/reuse/exit and database preflight failure.

validation.name: Change History regression tests
validation.detail: 6 retention, append and interaction tests passed; existing reports preserved.

validation.name: Static validation
validation.detail: App TypeScript check and focused ESLint no-undef/no-unused-vars checks passed. Initial standalone lint invocation omitted the Node __dirname global; corrected lint configuration passed.

validation.name: Live local startup and login transport
validation.detail: Combined npm run web -- --port 8082 started the missing API after a successful real database check. OPTIONS returned 204, empty login 400 INVALID_INPUT, synthetic invalid login 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS; all had the correct localhost:8082 CORS header. Frontend returned HTTP 200.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Actual owner password sign-in, browser visual interaction and native devices were not tested. Browser automation is unavailable in this session. No deployment. Database access requires network permission; the launcher reports failures and cannot guarantee availability during Internet or database outages.

title: Local login API restored and startup verified
